evals.prompt: Use Ant Design React to build an enterprise analytics overview dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Clean React component code utilizing official Ant Design 5.x components, layout grid, and design tokens.
expectations: Imports components strictly from official 'antd' package (Card, Row, Col, Statistic, Table, etc.)
Utilizes Ant Design 5.x Design Token system (e.g. useToken or ConfigProvider) rather than ad-hoc custom CSS
Structures page layout using Ant Design 24-column grid (Row, Col)
Leverages built-in AntD APIs for tables and loading states without unnecessary custom reimplementations
Maintains consistent Ant Design component prop naming and event conventions

evals.prompt: 将一段基于 Element Plus 的表单组件代码迁移重构为 Ant Design React 组件。
evals.expected_output: Accurate framework migration mapping Vue 3 Element Plus components, props, events, and validation rules to Ant Design 5.x React.
expectations: Correctly maps component names (ElForm -> Form, ElInput -> Input, ElSelect -> Select, ElButton -> Button)
Migrates event handlers accurately (@change / @input -> onChange, @submit.prevent -> onFinish)
Translates form validation rule schema (ElForm rules -> Form.Item rules)
Provides clear migration change log and rationale
